overview_description.description:
Census is the #1 Data Activation platform, powered by Reverse ETL. We transform the data warehouse into a hub for marketing and business operations, empowering everyone to take action with trusted, actionable data. No custom scripts or engineering favors required!

Hundreds of modern companies like Fivetran, Canva, Sonos, and Figma use Census to sync their customer data to the tools that business teams rely on, achieving outcomes like personalizing marketing for over 55 million users, improving sales productivity by 10x, and reducing support times by 98%.

We’d love to help you achieve better outcomes with trusted data – let’s chat!

about_short_description.short_description: A Data Activation and Reverse ETL platform that delivers trusted data and audiences from your data warehouse into 150+ operational tools.

product.name: Universal Data Platform
product.description: A cloud-native workspace for transforming, governing, and activating data from the warehouse to business tools via Reverse ETL.

product.name: Reverse ETL
product.description: A process and platform to sync data from cloud data warehouses to operational business tools in real time or batch mode.

product.name: Entity Resolution
product.description: A data management feature that merges duplicate records to create unified golden records across data sources.

product.name: AI Columns
product.description: A feature that applies AI models to enrich data with audience segmentation, intent scoring, and churn prediction directly in the warehouse.

product.name: Audience Hub
product.description: A no-code tool for building and managing dynamic audience segments and syncing them to business tools in real time.

product.name: Census Embedded
product.description: An embedded integration platform that enables SaaS companies to import and export customer data with 200+ integrations inside their own applications.
